Going downstream increases current and max movement speed, while going upstream inflicts no penalty

Streams are separated by two zones: ones with a 'strong current' which provides up to 150 bonus movement speed and ones with a 'moderate current' which provides up to 100 bonus speed. The current is 'strong' from stream beginnings near each base up to the waterfalls near T2 towers. All other stream sections are considered to have a 'moderate current'
Bonus value depends on the faced direction, ranging from 100% while going downstream to 0% at 90 degrees

Upon landing, heroes are stunned for 1s and take 200 pure damage + 0.5% of target's current health per minute of game time. Each time Roshan throws a hero, he gains 70 bonus movement speed and increases throw damage by additional 100 until he reaches his destination pit. After 5 throws Roshan ignores heroes on his way

Throw distance: 1500. Max bonus movespeed: 300. Can be blocked by spell-blocking abilities and items, like Linken's Sphere, but can't be reflected. Heroes will be thrown away from Roshan based on their relative position to him

Individual abilities no longer have special rules about how lifesteal works in different situations (heroes vs creeps vs illusions, damage types, etc.). Lifesteal mechanics are now consistent across every ability:
Lifesteal applies to physical damage from attacks and is reduced by 40% when damaging non-heroes
Spell Lifesteal now applies to physical damage from spells and magical damage from spells or attacks and is reduced by 80% when damaging non-heroes
Neither Lifesteal nor Spell Lifesteal applies to pure damage
Holding Alt while looking at items that provide Lifesteal or Spell Lifesteal will show the lifesteal percentages for attacking and casting spells, and targeting creeps vs heroes
The following sources and targets do not provide any lifesteal
Attacks that do not proc Attack Modifiers
Attack damage against wards, buildings, or couriers
Spell damage against illusions, wards, buildings, or couriers
Spells that remove Health instead of dealing direct damage
Effects that don't break Blink Dagger, like Orb of Venom or Necrophos' Heartstopper Aura
Any damage dealt to self or allies
A small number of abilities that do not use Lifesteal or Spell Lifesteal still result in healing and can benefit from Lifesteal Amp:
Holding Alt while looking at tooltips for these abilities will describe their interaction with Lifesteal Amp
Lifestealer's Open Wounds heals attackers for a percentage of the damage done
Lifestealer's Feast heals for a percentage of the target's max health
Meepo's Ransack heals all Meepos a flat amount for each strike

misc: Neutral Crafting
Neutral creeps no longer drop Neutral Tokens
Neutral Stash has been removed
Neutral Items can no longer be dropped or moved to the heroâ€™s backpack
When available, fully clearing a Neutral Creep Camp provides the player with Madstone
Collecting enough Madstone allows the player to craft a Neutral Item by selecting one Artifact and one Enchantment
Obtaining Madstone
Fully clearing a Neutral Creep Camp provides Madstone for the killing playerâ€™s team
The player who collects the Madstone receives 2 and 1 is given to a random teammate
Clearing an Ancient Creep Camp provides 3 to the killer and 2 are split between random teammates

Dropped Madstone is automatically collected if there are no enemy heroes within an 800 unit radius of the last creep to die and there is an allied hero within 1200 units of the dead creep. Otherwise, it is left on the ground where the creep died and can be collected by either team
Dropped Madstone automatically expires after 20 seconds
If the player who collects the Madstone is already at their limit (more info below), all of their Madstone is also evenly split between teammates
Item Tiers
Neutral Items are now composed of two parts: Artifacts & Enchantments
Artifacts are the ability of the item and can be passive and/or active
Enchantments provide passive stats and attributes to items
Similar to the previous Neutral Item System, items are arranged by Tiers
Each Tier is only available past a specific point in time
More info below
Each Artifact belongs to a single tier
Enchantments have multiple levels and can be found in multiple tiers
Crafting
When crafting, players are given a choice of 4 Artifacts and 4 Enchantments and choose one of each
Artifacts will provide 3 options from the current tier and the last option will be to keep the current Artifact
For Tier 1, players are given 4 random choices since they have no neutral item
Enchantments will provide 4 options from the current tier with no option to keep the current Enchantment
Given that Enchantments exist across multiple Tiers, it is possible that players can get the same Enchantment multiple Tiers in a row, but it is not guaranteed
Crafting a Neutral Item replaces the existing Neutral Item, if there is one
Players must craft a Tier 1 Neutral Item before they can craft a Tier 2 Neutral Item
And a Tier 2 before a Tier 3, etc
Crafting a Tier 1 Neutral Item takes 5 Madstone
Crafting Tier 2, 3, 4, or 5 Neutral Items takes 10 Madstone
Tier 5 Neutral Items can be recrafted for an escalating 10 Madstone cost
The first time a Tier 5 Neutral Item is recrafted the cost is 20 Madstone, then 30 Madstone, etc
Madstone Limits
Players are limited in the amount of Madstone they can obtain at any given point in time
At specific intervals, the limit will increase enough to allow players to craft the next Tier of Neutral Items
At the start of the game, the Madstone Cap is 0
No Madstone will drop from killed creep camps
At 5:00, the Madstone Cap is increased to 5
This is enough to craft a Tier 1 Neutral Item
At 15:00, the Madstone Cap is increased to 15
This is enough to craft a Tier 2 Neutral Item
At 25:00, the Madstone Cap is increased to 25
This is enough to craft a Tier 3 Neutral Item
At 35:00, the Madstone Cap is increased to 35
This is enough to craft a Tier 4 Neutral Item
At 60:00, the Madstone Cap is increased to 45
This is enough to craft a Tier 5 Neutral Item
At 70:00, the Madstone Cap is removed and players can collect infinite Madstone
This is so that the player can recraft their Tier 5 Neutral Item infinite times
Turbo
Madstone Availability times are halved in Turbo
Tier 1 items are available starting at 2:30
Collecting Madstone results in 3 Madstone for the player and 2 for their team
Ancient Creep Camps give 4 Madstone for the primary player and 3 for their team
